objective: Build Vital Rehearsal v1.0 as an externally usable, carefully bounded physiology/care-process research workbench, and produce three reproducible methodological or benchmark findings with appropriate review and limitations.
limits: Numerical research and synthetic process engineering only; not diagnosis, treatment, clinical validity or benefit.

Care scheduling remains independent; no scientifically reviewed coupling is admitted.
Human-qualified interpretation, external human reproduction, public release approval and Tanduna publication are separate pending gates.
